channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Bolsa-farelo' e voto contra a Constituição, debate provoca alta em buscas no Google
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on TV Globo led to a surge in Google searches, with users investigating past statements and episodes. Topics like 'Bolsa-farelo' and voting against the Constitution were discussed.

item.title: Em consideração final, Flávio aborda poder de compra, segurança e pede oração do Pai Nosso
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro questioned whether voters' lives have improved over the past four years and requested an Our Father prayer in his closing remarks. He addressed purchasing power and security as main themes.

item.title: Lula: Quem é amigo do Vorcaro é o Flávio, quem é filhote do Vorcaro é Flávio
item.description: In a TV Globo debate, Lula accused Daniel Vorcaro of corrupting the Republic and linked Flávio Bolsonaro to the scheme. Lula called Flávio 'Vorcaro's pup', suggesting involvement in corruption.

item.title: Lula diz que Willer Tomaz é 'sócio' de Flávio; senador diz que advogado é apenas um amigo
item.description: Lula accuses Flávio of having Willer Tomaz as a partner, while the senator denies it, calling him merely a friend. The debate centers around investigations into billionaire frauds at INSS.

item.title: Lula (PT): 'No governo do pai dele [Jair Bolsonaro, dizia que] quem tomava vacina ia virar gay. E ia virar jacaré'
item.description: Lula criticized Jair Bolsonaro for claiming, while in office, that vaccines could turn people gay or into caimans. Experts dismissed the statement as dangerous misinformation undermining vaccination efforts.

item.title: Flávio ou Lula, quem está na frente nas pesquisas? Veja números do 2º turno
item.description: Recent polls from October 21 to 23 show a tight race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a simulated runoff, with margins of error ranging from 1.6 to 2.4 percentage points. Both candidates display similar vote intentions, reflecting a highly competitive electoral scenario.

item.title: Bets, maioridade penal, SUS, dívidas: o que Flávio e Lula falaram no debate
item.description: Lula and Flávio exchanged accusations and presented proposals on economy, security, health, and social policies in the final debate before the runoff. The debate was marked by mutual criticisms and divergences on issues such as maximum penalty, SUS, and public debt.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido de Lula para proibir plataformas de recomendar perfis de Nikolas e Marçal
item.description: The TSE rejected Lula's request to prohibit Meta from recommending profiles of Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal. Corregidor Ricardo Villas Bôas Cuêva considered the measure could constitute undue censorship to freedom of expression. The decision was made during a virtual session on Tuesday.

item.title: Flávio recomenda Pai Nosso no debate; encerramento foi sugestão de Nikolas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) concluded his participation in the Globra debate by inviting voters to pray the Lord's Prayer, a suggestion made by federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) on social media. The gesture sparked mixed reactions among viewers and introduced a more personal and religious tone to the discussion.

item.title: Lula chama Jair de “pai do Tigrinho” e Flávio de “irmão do Tigrinho”
item.description: During a TV Globo debate in October 2026, Lula referred to Jair and Flávio Bolsonaro as 'father and brother of Tigrinho', criticizing the regulation of online betting. He highlighted the shutdown of Tigrinho platforms, banned by a provisional decree signed days earlier, and reinforced the prohibition of betting sites in Brazil. The measure, effective before the first-round vote, now awaits congressional approval.

item.title: Lula e Flávio melhoraram na Globo, mas petista venceu no saldo de pontos
item.description: Both Lula and Flávio improved in the Globo debate compared to the Band confrontation, but the PT candidate leads in net points. Lula emphasized past actions and forced Flávio to support proposals such as the real minimum wage increase and free fares, though he was criticized for focusing too much on the past. Flávio presented new promises, including zero tolls for motorcyclists, but had to respond to criticisms about controversial pandemic-era episodes.

item.title: TSE proíbe Nikolas e Marçal de publicarem conteúdo falso até a eleição sob pena de R$ 100 mil de multa
item.description: The TSE's general counsel, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, banned federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) and influencer Pablo Marçal from publishing false content until the end of the second-round election, with a fine of R$100,000 per post. The decision aims to protect the integrity of the electoral process and combat misinformation.

item.title: 'Nove dedos', 'miliciano, 'dá um Google': veja frases do debate entre Lula e Flávio na Globo
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro debated on TV Globo in the final round before the 2026 runoff election, discussing economy, security, health, and other key issues. The debate featured direct language and controversial exchanges with mutual criticism.

item.title: Lula diz que governo Bolsonaro “não acreditava na educação”
item.description: In the TV Globo debate, Lula criticized the Bolsonaro government for neglecting education and emphasized Camilo Santana's role in rebuilding school policies. He also attacked the model of civic-military schools, advocating for greater investment in public education.

item.title: 🔴 AO VIVO: LULA X FLÁVIO BOLSONARO NA GLOBO! ELEIÇÕES 2026
item.description: The video shows a live broadcast on Globo with Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro in an electoral debate for 2026. The content includes YouTube streaming technical elements and interface. No clear mention of specific political topics in the excerpt shown.

item.title: Mais Tarcísio e menos Marçal: Flávio foi melhor no debate, mas cometeu grosseria grave contra Lula
item.description: In a Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro outperformed Lula with a more statesman-like stance but committed a gaffe by referencing 'nine fingers' of the oil worker. Nevertheless, Lula countered by emphasizing his trajectory. Flávio’s performance may not be enough to halt Lula’s rising poll numbers.

item.title: "Parece que Flávio foi doutrinado e educado para mentir", acusa Lula
item.description: In a TV Globo debate, Lula accused Flávio Bolsonaro of repeatedly lying and being 'trained to lie', especially regarding the Master Bank and Richarlison island case. Flávio fired back saying Lula 'promises nothing' and compared his pledges to 'steak and pumpkin'. The candidates exchanged accusations over secrecy documents and corporate spending.

item.title: Debate na Globo: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) faz suas considerações finais; VÍDEO
item.description: In the Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva discussed topics such as economy, security and health. The debate was moderated by César Tralli and broadcast live by TV Globo, GloboNews and g1. Flávio Bolsonaro's closing remarks were highlighted in the video.

item.title: Lula cita mãe de Ana Clara na plateia e questiona Flávio sobre caso
item.description: In a Globo debate, Lula mentioned the presence of Ana Clara's mother in the audience and questioned Flávio Bolsonaro about his defense of the officer accused of killing the girl in 2021. Flávio expressed sympathy for the family but defended the officer's innocence and reinforced tougher sentencing positions.

item.title: Campanha que divide país tem de manter civilidade
item.description: The second-round campaign between Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula ends in polarization but maintains civility and peaceful democracy, without physical violence.

item.title: Debate na Globo: Lula (PT) faz suas considerações finais; VÍDEO
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) delivered his closing remarks in the Globo debate against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), broadcast live on TV Globo and g1 during the 2026 runoff election. The debate was moderated by César Tralli.

item.title: Flávio questiona quem banca Lulinha em bairro de luxo na Espanha
item.description: During a Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro questioned who funds Fábio Luís Lula da Silva's (Lulinha) lifestyle in Spain, referencing upscale residence and businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger.

item.title: 'Ana Clara, quero falar para a senhora': Flávio chama mãe de menina morta por PM pelo nome da filha em debate da Globo
item.description: During a TV Globo debate, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro mistakenly called Ana Clara's mother by her deceased daughter's name. The mother, Cristiane Gomes, reacted from the audience questioning why Flávio defended the accused officer. Lula used the case to criticize public security policies.

item.title: Veja como foi o debate entre Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e Lula (PT) na Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) debated in the presidential runoff on TV Globa, discussing debt, minimum wage, SUS, and exchanging insults. Fact Check verified their statements during the debate.

item.title: Lula pressiona Flávio Bolsonaro sobre ‘tesouraço’ e diz que rival é miliciano
item.description: Lula questioned Flávio Bolsonaro's economic and infrastructure proposals, linking him to Jair Bolsonaro's government and criticizing spending cuts that, he claimed, would harm the poor. Flávio denied the accusations, pledged to maintain Bolsa Família and raise the minimum wage, but did not explain how he would balance the budget. The debate took place amid a technical tie between the two candidates.

item.title: Segundo debate presidencial de Brasil, en vivo| Lula pasa a la ofensiva frente a un Bolsonaro que busca moderarse
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro participated in the second presidential debate with a technical tie at 50% in voting intentions. The debate takes place before the 2026 election runoff.

item.title: Debate na Globo: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro trocam acusações em bloco com tema livre; VÍDEO
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro exchange accusations during a Globo debate in the 2026 runoff. The confrontation aired live on TV Globo, GloboNews, and g1, moderated by César Tralli.

item.title: Lula e Flávio mudam o tom, debatem propostas pela 1ª vez, e exploram pontos fracos de ambos os lados
item.description: In their final pre-runoff debate, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro adopted a more conciliatory tone, focusing on policy proposals and avoiding personal attacks until the last segment. Lula warned about social risks under a Flávio administration, while Flávio pledged to protect the poor and renegotiate debts. The debate featured discussions on infrastructure, economy, and mutual criticism.

item.title: Mobilização progressista sobreviverá à eleição
item.description: The 2026 election is portrayed as a historically significant and risky vote for Brazilian democracy, marked by intense polarization between authoritarian and democratic paths. The progressive movement confronts a highly contested and uncertain political landscape, requiring civic and political engagement to uphold social rights and popular sovereignty.

item.title: A esquerda já perdeu
item.description: On the eve of the runoff, Lula trails Flávio Bolsonaro numerically and relies on promises funded by R$200 billion. The left is politically defeated, minority in Congress and distant from the country. The tone suggests an unfavorable scenario for the left.

item.title: Congresso superpoderoso aguarda o novo governo
item.description: The October 4 elections renewed only 35.7% of the Chamber seats, maintaining power concentration in Congress. The victory of the PL and far-right groups in the Senate strengthens movements threatening Supreme Court powers, indicating a trend toward weakening institutional checks and balances.

item.title: Flávio erra e chama de “Ana Clara” mãe de menina vítima de fuzil
item.description: In a Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro mistakenly called the mother of Ana Clara, a girl killed by rifle fire in Rio, by her daughter's name and expressed solidarity to the family. He was questioned by Lula about defending the accused military police officer. The debate featured personal attacks and few policy proposals.

item.title: “A vida do Lula é um laranjal”, diz Flávio em debate
item.description: In a Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) criticized Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), questioning public spending transparency and a dispute over an island linked to footballer Richarlison. He used the phrase 'Lula's life is an orange grove' to attack the president.

item.title: Eleições 2026: acompanhe a apuração em todo o Brasil no 2º turno
item.description: The 2026 elections advance to the runoff with real-time count coverage by g1, featuring a race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for the presidency. In addition to the presidential race, voters in five states and the Federal District elect governors. Detailed results by state, city, and polling stations are available on the g1 results page.

item.title: Vai chover no domingo de 2º turno? Veja a previsão do tempo para as 27 capitais do Brasil
item.description: On Sunday (25), 27 Brazilian capitals will face variable weather conditions during the 2nd round of the 2026 elections, with rain expected mainly in the Southeast and South and intense heat in the North. Tens of millions of voters will vote to elect the president and governors in five states and the Federal District, while meteorology warns of possible changes in voting schedules.

item.title: Em entrevista após debate, Flávio Bolsonaro disse que vai manter proteção ambiental, mas sem 'questões ideológicas'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated, after a TV Globo debate, that he will maintain environmental protection actions but criticized the ideological stance of Ibama and ICMbio. He promised to fight illegal deforestation by 2029 with support from the Armed Forces. During the debate, he exchanged criticisms with Lula, discussing topics like the economy, health, and security.

item.title: Debate na Globo: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro se enfrentam antes do 2º turno
item.description: In the Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro said his government plan aims to end illegal deforestation in the Amazon by 2029, criticized the IBAMA and ICMBio, and defended that institutions should stop acting ideologically. He also stated he will govern thinking about the future, contrasting himself with Lula.

item.title: Flávio leva governadores eleitos e deixa Marçal de fora do debate da Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro gathers elected governors in his entourage for the Globo debate, excluding influencer Pablo Marçal, who supported him in the pre-campaign. The strategy reinforces institutional alliances to expand support in the 2026 election.

item.title: Troca de seções eleitorais foi solicitada por tribunais estaduais
item.description: The exchange of polling sections was requested by state courts, not by a unilateral decision from the TSE president. The change aims to prevent unforeseen events on election day, as clarified by the Regional Electoral Courts.

item.title: Pazolini aciona Justiça contra ataques por telefone disfarçados de pesquisa no ES
item.description: Lorenzo Pazolini's coalition (Republicanos) filed a criminal complaint with the TSE of Espírito Santo against automated calls disguised as polls that attack Pazolini and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The campaign alleges these calls mislead voters to discredit the candidates.

item.title: Lula usa último programa para atacar Flávio, e rival aposta em sertanejos e oração
item.description: In the final stretch, Lula and Flávio release contrasting campaign ads: Lula focuses on attacks over corruption and proposed cuts, whereas Flávio leans on country singer endorsements and prayers without direct confrontations.

item.title: Alckmin faz agenda ao lado de Paes no Rio, e defende reta final sem 'interferência' do TSE nos canais de WhatsApp
item.description: Geraldo Alckmin defended that the TSE should not interfere in WhatsApp channels during the final stretch of the 2026 elections, during an event in Rio de Janeiro alongside Eduardo Paes. He criticized the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel and emphasized the importance of dialogue with voters regarding health and education. Surveys show a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in the runoff.

item.title: Doria com Flávio, Cabral com Lula: o peso dos apoios na reta final
item.description: In the final stretch of the runoff, João Doria announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro, while Sérgio Cabral released a video backing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Renan Santos of the Missão movement claimed voters for candidate 22 are 'humiliated', and on Papo Antagonista, Duda Teixeira, Gabriel Oliveira and Carlos Graieb analyzed the strategies behind these last-minute endorsements.

item.title: Flávio pagou R$ 1,6 milhão a impulsionamento de posts contra Lula em 3 dias
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) spent $1.6 million boosting 19 anti-Lula posts on Meta platforms between October 20-22. Lula's campaign requested disqualification over economic power abuse, while Meta denies preferential treatment of posts.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro x Lula no debate da Globo: horário, onde assistir ao vivo e regras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula debate on Globo at 9:30 PM, divided into four blocks with set time rules. The debate is live on TV Globo, GloboNews and digital platforms, mediated by César Tralli.

item.title: As comitivas de peso dos candidatos no debate da TV Globo
item.description: President Lula will attend the TV Globo debate accompanied by key allies including Camilo Santana and Rafael Fonteles. Prominent opposition figures such as Haddad and Marina Silva were absent from the event, with André Janones focusing on social media outreach.

item.title: “Quem checa os checadores?”: o problema da checagem no debate
item.description: Lula's campaign requested real-time fact-checking during the TV Globo debate, while Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign threatened legal action. The hosts of Papo Antagonista discuss whether it is appropriate for a moderator to assess the truthfulness of candidates' statements.

item.title: Deputado eleito pelo PL confronta professor por vídeo eleitoral para alunos
item.description: Elected federal deputy Victor Jansen (PL) confronted a teacher at CEM Urso Branco over a video making a political-electoral appeal to students. The teacher was accused of using his position to influence students, which the lawmaker deemed a form of political indoctrination. The District Federal Secretariat of Education forwarded the case to its ombudsman for investigation.

item.title: Em podcast, Eduardo Bolsonaro questiona urnas e defende que Flávio deixe o País se perder eleição
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro suggested that Flávio leave the country if he loses the election and questioned the reliability of electronic voting machines on the 'Louder with Crowder' podcast. He also commented on potential investigations against his brother after losing parliamentary immunity.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula se enfrentam no último debate da eleição
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro faced off in the final presidential debate on Globo, lasting nearly two and a half hours. The debate was marked by accusations, particularly regarding corruption, with Flávio calling Lula 'nine fingers' and the PT candidate retaliating with references to militia. The broadcaster set rules including time limits per block and restrictions on movement during the opponent's speech.
